command: set -euo pipefail; echo HOST=$(hostname); echo USER=$(id -un); systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveState -p MainPID -p ActiveEnterTimestamp --no-pager || true; echo FRANKENSTEIN_REPO_BEGIN; if [ -d /home/andreas/frankenstein-repo/.git ]; then git -C /home/andreas/frankenstein-repo rev-parse HEAD; git -C /home/andreas/frankenstein-repo branch --show-current; git -C /home/andreas/frankenstein-repo status --porcelain; for f in omega_unified_ingest.py omega_grid_unified_ingest.py omega_grid_source_envelope.py omega_grid_source_guard.py; do if [ -f /home/andreas/frankenstein-repo/scripts/$f ]; then echo SCRIPT_PRESENT=$f; else echo SCRIPT_MISSING=$f; fi; done; fi; echo FRANKENSTEIN_REPO_END; for DB in /home/andreas/.local/share/agentzero/unified.db /var/lib/entityos/data/unified.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/unified.db; do echo DB_BEGIN=$DB; if [ ! -f "$DB" ]; then echo MISSING=1; echo DB_END=$DB; continue; fi; stat -c 'SIZE=%s MODE=%a UID=%u GID=%g MTIME=%y' "$DB"; sqlite3 "file:$DB?mode=ro" "PRAGMA query_only=ON; SELECT 'INTEGRITY='||integrity_check FROM pragma_integrity_check LIMIT 1; SELECT 'TABLE='||name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name IN ('artikel','f2_runtime_epoch','f2_grid10_frame','f2_grid10_observation','f2_grid10_source_ingest') ORDER BY name; SELECT 'TRIGGER='||name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='trigger' AND name='f2_guard_omega_source_grid_only';" 2>&1 || echo SQLITE_READ_RC=$?; if sqlite3 "file:$DB?mode=ro" "SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='f2_runtime_epoch';" | grep -q 1; then sqlite3 "file:$DB?mode=ro" "SELECT 'LATEST_EPOCH='||runtime_epoch_id FROM f2_runtime_epoch ORDER BY rowid DESC LIMIT 1;"; fi; echo DB_END=$DB; done; echo DONE=1
